---
title: "Publications"
description: "Peer-reviewed publications and patents by Dominic Bräm on machine learning in pharmacometrics, dose optimisation, and paediatric clinical pharmacology."
freeze: false
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
source("R/site.R")
pubs <- site_data("publications")
n_first <- sum(vapply(pubs, is_first_author, TRUE))
```

`r length(pubs)` peer-reviewed articles, `r n_first` of them as first author. Up-to-date lists and citation metrics are on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=3uPj-l8AAAAJ) and [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9094-8361).

```{r}
#| output: asis
publications_by_year()
```

## Patents

```{r}
#| output: asis
for (p in site_data("cv")$patents) {
  out(div(class = "pub",
          div(class = "pub-title", p$title),
          div(class = "pub-authors", authors_html(p$authors)),
          div(class = "pub-meta", p$status)))
}
```
